crossRefs.note: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

translations.web: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
translations.bsb: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
